Our story

Started in 1987 with a single table at the farmers’ market, The Copper Kettle is now a two-room shop full of furniture, lighting, kitchenware, and curiosities from the 1920s to the 1970s. We buy estates locally and sell everything as found — cleaned, never refinished beyond repair.
